bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed in the venue and will be searched prior to entry. Non-clear bags will undergo additional searches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking options and pricing details are not provided on the venue's website. Visitors are encouraged to check nearby parking facilities or use public transportation. Consider arriving early to secure parking.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Citizens House of Blues's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Citizens House of Blues in Boston offers a variety of food and drink options, including shareable bites like jambalaya arancini and chicken wings, handhelds such as a double cheeseburger and po'boy, and desserts like bananas foster bread pudding. The drink menu features signature cocktails, draft and craft beers, and a selection of wines and sangria.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Citizens House of Blues, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Citizens House of Blues's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens day of show ONLY starting one hour prior to doors.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: It is encouraged that guests who require accessible accommodations arrive 30 minutes prior to doors opening.
